text.tspan: CELTIC TICKET EXCHANGE — the whole flow, spark to shipped
a worked example through every agreed rung · drawn 2026-08-04
skills + tools in the right gutter · the flow is the WALK's agreed system, not today's tooling.
DECISIONS are dashed · ARTIFACTS are listed right
RED — cost, or a route that leaves the stage / blocks it
GREEN — Tony's input into the work: his annotations, his corrections
BLUE — changed since you last marked this reviewed
RED BOX — a place where Tony must think more deeply before the flow may pass (overrides red=cost, boxes only)
SPARK
An idea arrives: Celtic Ticket Exchange
'an app where Celtic season-ticket holders pass their seat to
another fan for matches they can't attend.' a bare idea — nothing
declared, nothing on disk. the ENTRY GATES push it to the top:
no rung below PRODUCT will admit work whose inputs don't exist.
tools: none yet — the gates
themselves route. today's only
gate instance is conductor's
pre-flight inventory.
FRAME
Frame the intent → an IDEA BRIEF
triage: NEW. one conversation produces docs/product/
celtic-ticket-exchange.md + .excalidraw: what it is · what it must
become · the gap (matchday seats sit empty while fans want in) ·
comparison — Twickets, StubHub, the club's own exchange · THE
VALUE, measurable · a viability SIGNAL, not a verdict · the next
stage's inputs. grounding: competitor scan + evidence of need +
what we ruled out (empty on day one — read anyway, by rule).
skills: sensei IF its route
matches (asserting a position).
sherpa Explore is the drafted
server — unused today.
acceptance: machine key +
Tony approves the brief.
DEEPER — THE VALUE, IN UNITS. what is this worth, and to whom:
empty seats filled? fan goodwill? money? every fatal-risk verdict
and every priority call downstream divides by this number, and it
has exactly one source: you.
VIABILITY
Test viability → qualify the killer assumption
every candidate-fatal risk gets EVIDENCE — a test or an analysis —
impact in the value's units, likelihood recorded separately, never
multiplied. candidates here: will fans list through a non-club
app? can a seat actually transfer inside the club's ticketing
system? is resale even lawful? a risk left unqualified reads as
managed — that is the failure this stage exists to stop.
skills: interrogate serves
this today. the SPIKE is the
cheapest test of the killer
assumption — declared, cheap,
kill-or-keep.
DEEPER — UK LAW MAKES UNAUTHORISED FOOTBALL TICKET RESALE A
CRIMINAL OFFENCE (s.166 CJPOA 1994 — from training data; have
counsel verify). impact >= the declared value at ANY likelihood =
FATAL. the only countermeasure class visible is CLUB AUTHORISATION
— which makes partner-with-Celtic the survival condition, not a
feature. face-value-only exchange between verified holders may be
the one lawful shape. this risk can reshape or kill the idea.
SLICE
Slice a release · Set the goal
a release is a GROUPING, not a date. MVP candidate: verified
season-ticket holders only · home league games · face value only
(the lawful shape) · one club-blessed pilot stand. dependency
forbids groupings, what a user can absorb caps them, effort/risk/
opportunity shape the rest. DONE is ASSEMBLED: every item is a
check against something an earlier stage declared.
skills: sherpa Launch drafted
for this — unused today.
risk arrives PRE-QUALIFIED
from viability; never
re-argued here.
CHOOSE
Choose what matters next
two axes, both outcome: consequence × value. every candidate names
WHAT WE LOSE by not choosing it; blocked items are separated, not
ranked. the first pick writes itself: the club-authorisation
conversation — highest consequence, and it gates everything else
on this page.
view: a choose-what-matters
board, regenerated per
decision.
DESIGN
Design the solution → ONE package
one conversation → docs/design/celtic-ticket-exchange.md +
.excalidraw: detailed specs, architecture (ticket custody, QR
re-issue, seat map, identity), testing strategy, diagrams for as
many aspects as we can. grounding: standing decisions · what we
ruled out · the living design docs of whatever this touches.
GO is two keys: everything drawn and nothing left to annotate
(you) · every stage-2 measurement has a NAMED ANSWER (machine).
GO writes docs/gates/<date>-celtic-ticket-exchange-design.md.
tools: superpowers
brainstorming CAPABILITY
(2-3 approaches) without its
waterfall · excalidraw round
trip · A3 story formats.
hands to CONTRACT — never
writing-plans.
CONTRACT
Write the contract · Size and assign
the design package arrives INTACT — never a digest. the work
order: self-contained pieces ('listing service', 'seat-transfer
flow', 'holder-verification screen'), each carrying its own check,
sized and assigned AFTER writing. two-tier access: the overseer
holds all truth; each builder gets exactly its piece plus related
materials. NO human gate — every piece measurable against an
upstream declaration, or pushed back to design.
tools: conductor's spec
machinery is today's instance.
sizing declares tier + effort
+ why, per piece — the
ladder's roles made
computable.
LOOP
Drive to done — unattended
next unblocked piece → build → prove against ALL RELEVANT specs →
commit as it verifies → repeat. the driver holds nothing: state
lives in the declared artifacts, so it cuts and resumes fresh
between pieces. every question rides the LADDER — builder →
overseer → intent-holder → you — and only a role-unanswerable
blocker reaches you. the liveness view ticks at every piece
boundary: landed · in flight · remaining. motion, not 'working…'.
tools: /goal + /loop (future),
conductor + sized players
(today). show-where-we-are
pushed at each piece boundary
and each stage close.
DEEPER — THE LOOP MAY NOT RUN YET. nothing in any repo can refuse
from outside the model: 0 CI workflows, 0 hooks. until a check can
BLOCK, this page is a description, not a machine. CI is the first
build item for exactly this reason — and deciding its shape (what
refuses, where, on what signal) is yours.
GOAL
GATE
Prove the whole · Goal gate
cold eyes see ONLY the work order and the change — verdict can
BLOCK. per-layer conformance, never one verdict: code · logic ·
architecture · pixel vs the approved design · the product
measurements (an exchange completes end-to-end, the seat
transfers, the empty-seat number moves). then the human key.
this is the escalation
contract's promised report:
GOAL ACHIEVED — the first
thing you hear since the
contract was written.
DEEPER — YOUR EXPERT-USER PASS, DEFINED. what do you DO to say
goal achieved: list a real ticket, transfer it to a real fan,
stand at the turnstile when the QR scans? the pass is experiential
by design — naming its scenario is the one gate only you can write.
SHIPPED
Release shipped → the flow repeats
the gate record is dated and kept; the code IS the product truth;
what was ruled out is on the record and read in grounding by the
next round — a dead option stays dead. the next slice (away
fixtures? cup games? guest passes?) enters at the gates — and
enters LOWER, because its upstream declarations now exist.
switch + kivna keep the
boundary · the vault tells the
human story · git holds every
declaration the checks
measure against.
